result.description: Compact handheld calibration tool designed for textile studios, print shops, and mobile brand teams. The Arcbook 14 measures color patches, stores custom profiles, and syncs wirelessly to design software for quick soft-proof verification. It includes an OLED status display, USB-C charging, and a protected carrying sleeve for field use.
result.title: Nimble Loom Arcbook 14 Portable Color Calibrator
